features.name: Fix sanitiseAnswer() silently eating hyphenated user-message text before a colon

stories.name: Fix sanitiseAnswer() silently eating hyphenated user-message text before a colon
stories.notes: Root cause: tests/e2e/a4-ideate-session-resume.spec.js AC2/AC3 failed against real wuce-staging -- resumed chat thread showed user message truncated ("call it Project: an internal tool..." instead of the full "Project-Codename-Falcon-detail-...: an internal tool..."). Isolated and ruled out both lightMd (skills.js) and lightMarkdown (chat-view.js) directly with the exact failing input -- neither reproduces it. Actual root cause: sanitiseAnswer() (src/answer-sanitiser.js) CLI_FLAG regex /--?[a-z][w-]*/gi has no boundary check on what precedes the leading hyphen, so it matches and deletes an entire hyphenated compound-word span mid-sentence, at write time, before the turn is ever pushed to session.turns -- a real, permanent corruption of any user own stored chat history matching this shape, not a render-time or session-restore bug. Fix: added a negative lookbehind (?<![w-]) so a flag is only recognised at a genuine token boundary. Verified: 8/8 new unit tests passing (RED confirmed pre-fix including through the real htmlSubmitTurn() write path, GREEN post-fix); all pre-existing sanitiser tests (T4.3/T4.5/NFR3/T4.4 in tests/skill-launcher.test.js) still pass unmodified; full npm test run shows zero new regressions vs tests/known-baseline-failures.json (the one delta, check-s6.1-cache-scope-session-threading.js, independently reproduced as failing identically on origin/master before this fix -- a pre-existing baseline-file drift, not a regression introduced by this change). Merged via PR #571.
